register.labelZh: CHANGE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: CHANGE 片語動詞可以清楚表示某人換上另一套衣服、換下濕或骯髒的衣服,或換回之前穿着的衣服。；change down 和 change up 可以表示在斜坡、彎位或暢通道路上轉用較低或較高波檔。；change over 可以表示改用新的系統或方法;change over 和 change round 也可以表示兩人互換工作或位置。；你可以用 CHANGE 片語動詞表示某地方改作新用途、某物改回原來狀態,或多件物品重新排列。
register.summaryEn: CHANGE expressions let you show whether someone puts on different clothes, removes wet or dirty clothes, or returns to clothes worn earlier. Change down and change up help you describe moving to a lower or higher gear on hills, bends and open roads. Change over can describe using a new system or method, while change over and change round can describe two people swapping jobs or positions. You can use CHANGE expressions to show that a place gains a new use, an object returns to an earlier state, or items are put in a different order.
